correctness.rationale: The half-line moments yield W=|v|²M(w)/(2a), with det M=r² and trace 1+r²+|w|². Thus v≠0 is necessary and sufficient and the condition number is minimized uniquely at w=0. For a unit sensor set d=1+|w−r|²; the determinant of M−dI/2 is one quarter of 4r²−(1+r²+|w|²)²+4r²(Re w)², the stated negative square. At determinant zero the smaller eigenvalue reaches d/2 only for the nonnegative real root: the negative root at r>1 has d>2; the positive root has d<2 and gives a positive semidefinite rank-one difference. At r=1 the roots merge and the difference is zero. Sensors with v=0 have zero lower bound; compactness gives a strictly sub-ceiling maximum for r<1 and the positive real-direction derivative at w=0 for r≠1 proves the split.
